perks.summary: With a bow wielded the troop's accuracy penalty while moving (WeaponMaxMovementAccuracyPenalty) is cut by 30%.
perks.conditions: Bow wielded. Effect reduced at sea (NavalReduced).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the agent's own character, bow branch
captain half (+5% bow damage to formation)

perks.rbm: RBMAI SetAiRelatedProperties postfix multiplies WeaponMaxMovementAccuracyPenalty (*0.33 bow, *0.1 mounted, stamina) after the perk, so the perk's factor is preserved (AgentStats.cs:169, :205, :324).

perks.summary: Bow headshots by the troop deal +30% damage.
perks.conditions: Missile from a bow hits the victim's head (AttackInformation.IsHeadShot = hit body part Head). Reduced at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's own character, bow consumable + IsHeadShot
captain half (+20 bow skill to formation)

perks.rbm: ApplyDamageAmplifications still runs on RBM's computed damage via Mission.GetAttackCollisionResults -> CalculateDamage (bypass map note 8). Applies on top of RBM's face-hit armor logic.

perks.summary: The troop's arrows treat the target's armor as 10% lower.
perks.conditions: Bow ammunition against an armored hit location (armor > 0). Reduced at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's own character
naval copy of the same personal check
RBM calls CalculateAdjustedArmorForBlow and uses the result as armorAmount (and its ratio on face/under-shoulder hits, :311/:333)

perks.rbm: ComputeBlowDamage is skipped (bypass #1) but RBM re-calls CalculateAdjustedArmorForBlow, so the armor reduction feeds RBM's penetration math. Nothing lost.

perks.summary: A wielded bow no longer adds its extra length-and-weight encumbrance, so the troop moves faster with a bow in hand.
perks.conditions: Bow is the wielded (primary hand) item. Only removes the wielded-weapon term (4*sqrt(length)*weight); the bow's plain weight still counts like any carried weapon. Reduced at sea.

sites.why: characterObject.GetPerkValue(env overload) on the agent's own character; result feeds WeaponsEncumbrance -> MaxSpeedMultiplier/CombatMaxSpeedMultiplier/TopSpeedReachDuration

perks.rbm: No RBM patch touches WeaponsEncumbrance; RBMCombat's UpdateHumanStats postfix only sets the shield missile-collision adder, RBMAI only scales speed by stamina (*=).

perks.summary: +25% bow reload speed for the troop.

sites.why: RBM re-applies the perk as a factor on its own ReloadSpeed

perks.rbm: RBMCombat overwrites ReloadSpeed for bow/long_bow usages (bypass #8) but multiplies RapidFire back in via GetReloadPerkFactor. Where RBM does not assign (other usages, player on vanilla reload), vanilla's perk value stays.

perks.summary: On foot the troop's accuracy penalty while turning with a bow is halved; on horseback RBM replaces that stat with a fixed value, so the perk does nothing there.
perks.conditions: Bow wielded; effective only while not mounted (with RBM AI on). Reduced at sea.

sites.why: mounted bow user: WeaponRotationalAccuracyPenaltyInRadians = 0.015f, discarding the perk

perks.rbm: Bypass #9(b): RBMAI assigns a constant rotational penalty to mounted bow users after the perk is applied. Lost for horse archers (only when rbmAiEnabled); foot archers keep it.

perks.summary: Party size / governor militia perk; nothing for a troop.
While mounted with a bow, the troop's movement and unsteady accuracy penalties are cut by 30%.
perks.conditions: Mounted, bow wielded, land battles only (LandOnly).

sites.why: one-arg GetPerkValue gate + AddPerkBonusForCharacter x2 on own character (WeaponMaxMovementAccuracyPenalty, WeaponMaxUnsteadyAccuracyPenalty), agent.HasMount

perks.rbm: RBMAI multiplies both fields for mounted bow users (*0.1, *0.2, stamina) after the perk; multiplicative, so preserved.

perks.summary: Party-leader daily XP perk; nothing for a troop.
+8% damage with the troop's arrows.
perks.conditions: Bow ammunition hitting an agent (CollisionBoneIndex != -1). Reduced at sea.
perks.rbm: Damage-amplification pipeline intact under RBM (bypass map note 8).

perks.summary: The troop can hold a drawn bow 50% longer before its aim starts to shake.
perks.conditions: Bow wielded (code is in the bow branch although the perk is flagged for all ranged users). Reduced at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on own character: WeaponUnsteadyBeginTime and WeaponUnsteadyEndTime (:1042)

perks.summary: +30% damage with the troop's arrows against horses.
perks.conditions: Bow ammunition hitting a mount (IsVictimAgentMount). Land battles only.

perks.summary: The troop takes 10% less damage from all projectiles (arrows, bolts, javelins, stones), and so does its horse.
perks.conditions: Attacker weapon is a consumable (any missile). Applies when the troop's mount is hit too (victim character resolves to the rider). Not bow-specific: works for any troop. Reduced at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the victim's own character (rider character when the mount is hit)

perks.rbm: Damage-reduction pipeline intact under RBM. Shield-on-back hits never wound under RBM (bypass #13/#15), so the perk only matters for body hits.

perks.summary: Bow zoom only affects the player's camera, and the player is always a hero, so a troop gets nothing.

sites.why: check is on the agent's CharacterObject, but the only caller is Mission for MainAgent (Mission.cs:2299)

perks.summary: Party battle-XP / governor garrison-XP perk; nothing for a troop.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForParty (hero); RBM keeps it via reflection (CampaignChanges.Xp.cs)

perks.summary: Party-leader morale / recruit-cost perk; nothing for a troop.
perks.rbm: RBMCampaign also reads it for upgrade/recruit cost (Upgrades/RBMCampaignPatches.cs:45, Economy/RecruitSupply.cs:311), heroes/parties only.

perks.summary: Using every bow on horseback is an agent flag set only for heroes; a troop gets nothing.

sites.why: captain half (+30 bow skill to mounted troops)

perks.rbm: Listed in TroopPerks.NoTroopEffectPerkIds (HeroOnly, RBMConfig/Shared/TroopPerks.cs); the loader logs it as having no effect.

perks.summary: Each arrow stack the troop carries gets +3 arrows at spawn.
perks.conditions: Bow ammunition slots, applied once when the agent is built. Reduced at sea.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on own character; called from Agent.Build for every agent

party-leader half reads PartyBaseHelper.GetVisualPartyLeader's CharacterObject, which is the first roster troop in a party with no leader hero; a troop granted DeepQuivers there gives +1 arrow per stack to the party's other bow users

perks.rbm: No RBM patch on InitializeMissionEquipment or arrow amounts (RangedRework's ammo refill is siege-defender javelins/axes only).

perks.summary: +25% bow draw (ready) speed for the troop.
perks.rbm: RBMAI only scales ThrustOrRangedReadySpeedMultiplier by stamina (*=); RBM's item-stat rewrites change the bow's base speed, the multiplier still applies on top.

perks.summary: The troop's movement-speed penalty while reloading is halved.
perks.conditions: Any ranged weapon wielded: the personal call sits outside the bow branch, so crossbows and throwing weapons benefit too. Reduced at sea.

sites.why: captain half (+3% speed to foot archers)

perks.rbm: RBMAI sets ReloadMovementPenaltyFactor = 0.1 only for non-ranged agents in infantry formations (AgentStats.cs:269), which never covers a ranged shooter; moot.

perks.summary: For each Bow skill point above 200 the troop gets +0.2% bow reload speed and +0.5% bow damage.
perks.conditions: Troop's raw Bow skill (CharacterObject.GetSkillValue) above 200; nothing at 200 or below. Reduced at sea.

sites.why: AddEpicPerkBonusForCharacter primary (ReloadSpeed); overwritten by RBM, see rbm
RBM re-applies the epic reload bonus as a factor

perks.rbm: Reload half: RBMCombat assigns ReloadSpeed (bypass #8) and multiplies Deadshot back in. Damage half untouched.
